completion.description: The credential version the grant created, once completed.

interval.description: How many seconds to wait before the next status request, while pending. The upstream may ask OLP to slow down, which lengthens it.

status.description: `pending` until the operator approves the device upstream; `completed` once the grant created a credential version; `denied` when the operator denied the device; `expired` when the device authorization expired first.

classification.description: Declared failure classification, in order: the first rule that matches an upstream failure decides its class. OLP's built-in rules classify every failure no rule matches.

force_streaming.description: The upstream serves only streaming requests. OLP sends every request as a streaming one and aggregates the stream into the dialect's non-streaming result for a caller that did not ask to stream. Only openai-responses profiles may force streaming.

headers.description: Declared request headers by name, with value templates.

query.description: Declared query parameters by name, with value templates.

rewrites.description: Declared changes to the dialect's request body, applied in order before the envelope wraps it.

fields.description: The request object's other members by name, with value templates in which {model} stands for the upstream model and {options.<name>} for the provider's value of one of the profile's required options. They become JSON strings.

request.description: The member of the upstream's request object that carries the dialect's request body.

response.description: The member of the upstream's responses and stream events that carries the dialect's response or event.

op.description: set replaces the member, default sets it unless the request has it, and delete removes it.

models.description: The top-level field of the listing that holds the array of model objects.

path.description: The listing's path, which extends the address, such as /models.

class.description: credential cools the credential version and fails over; rate_limited cools the slot, for the upstream's Retry-After, and fails over; retryable fails over unless the upstream may have performed work that must not repeat; terminal returns the rejection without failing over.

status.description: The unsuccessful response's HTTP status. A rule with a status never matches an in-band error.

cursor.description: The top-level field of a page that holds the next page's cursor.

more.description: The top-level boolean field of a page that reports whether another page follows.

parameter.description: The query parameter that carries the cursor.

configured.description: Whether an explicit policy exists. False represents inherited defaults with a fresh observed ETag after removal.
